# EXN Lube Singapore

> EXN Lube engine oils, gearbox fluids and +Care car care products for Singapore drivers and workshops, distributed in Singapore by KohDen International Pte Ltd (authorised distributor of DENSO, EXN, MOON and Hyper Power). Preview site.

## Key facts
- Singapore distributor: KohDen International Pte Ltd, 7 Kaki Bukit Road 1, #01-15 Eunos Technolink, Singapore 415937
- Phone: +65 6966 6565; email kohden2019@yahoo.com; WhatsApp +65 8603 0355
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Saturday and Sunday closed.
- EXN range on Kohden: https://www.kohden.com.sg/product-category/exn/
- Technology: Molytech (buckyball nano particles that act like ball bearings to cut friction, heat and drag)
- Sister Kohden brands: Hyper Power https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/hyper-power/ ; Carku https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/carku/

## Engine oils
- EXN Extentios Hybrid 0W-16: API SP; Fully synthetic; 4L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 0W-20: API SN/CF, ACEA A5/B5; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L or 1L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-30: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L or 1L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-40: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L or 1L
- EXN Extentios Molyracing 5W-50: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4, C3; Fully synthetic (PAO and ester); 4L or 1L
- EXN Carios Molytech Nano 5W-30: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4; Molytech nano formula; 4L
- EXN Carios Molytech Nano 10W-40: API SN/CF, ACEA A3/B4; Molytech nano formula; 4L
